comment: Worked out by hand. Block: a 20 x 10 x 5 box with its top taken out (Top, 200 at z 5): five faces left as a surface, 2 (20 5) + 2 (10 5) + 200 = 500. Walls: the walls of a 20 x 10 rectangle at x 40..60, 5 high, trimmed at z 2.5 (the parameter cut), the upper half kept: 60 x 2.5 = 150, then turned inside out (no change in shape). Holed: a 20 x 10 plate 5 thick at x 80..100 with a hole of radius 2, 1000 - 20 pi = 937.168. Filled: its top without the hole, 200 at z 5.
